note: Lawn-replacement rebate terms for the utilities serving the CA-10 corridor. Every figure here is in the verify-before-launch register and must be re-checked against each utility's own page before the submission video — rebate programs change rates, caps, and eligibility without notice, and a stale number on screen is money we promised someone.
universal_warning: Apply and get approval BEFORE you remove anything. Every one of these programs requires a pre-conversion inspection, and work started early is not eligible — the rebate is void even if the finished yard would have qualified.

tiers.label: Standard
tiers.requirements: Replace lawn with low-water plants or permeable hardscape.

tiers.label: Super Rebate
tiers.requirements: Higher rate where the new planting meets the native-plant requirement. Check current eligibility with EBMUD before assuming this rate.

water_savings.basis: Approximate annual saving from replacing cool-season turf with low-water planting in the Contra Costa / Tri-Valley climate, derived from local evapotranspiration. An estimate, and presented as one — actual saving depends on what replaces the lawn and how it is irrigated.
